rule: No quality metric, technology integration, protected fix, Golden component, certified app contract or critical test may regress.

comparison.protectedErrors: accepted protected ids must remain protected
comparison.goldenComponents: accepted canonical solution must remain, unless verified migration exists
comparison.certifiedApps: accepted certified app must remain certified and keep all required capabilities
comparison.criticalTests: accepted critical test files must remain present
comparison.sourceGate: Golden Standard static/source checks must pass

improvementRules: A percentage increase must have an evidence record.
A confirmed fix must become a protected regression rule.
A user-approved reusable success must become a Golden Component.
A Golden replacement requires an explicit verified migration record.
A new release-blocking error stops release until protected/fixed.
One metric may not be traded down to improve another.

externalEnforcementRequired.note: Without GitHub branch protection a human/integration can still push directly to master; CI will detect it after push but cannot prevent the Git ref from moving.
